Same-run production universal leaf updates at 4,000 unrelated siblings versus none. The fixed scoped path measures near 1x; 8x leaves sub-millisecond timer/JIT headroom while rejecting both the former whole-root replay (hundreds of times slower) and the object-driver full-map clone (tens of times slower).

State in the root component replays from the root range, and every clean leaf subtree is adopted without re-rendering (issue #574 follow-up). The dirty twin rewrites all 4,000 leaf props per press, so it must re-render each leaf; the clean run measures well under half of that (~0.25x observed). A ratio near 1x means retained-subtree adoption stopped engaging and clean leaves are re-rendering again.

One keyed @for item's setState hoists to its 20-item list component instead of replaying the root, so 4,000 out-of-scope siblings must not change its cost. Rejects the anonymous-owner bail that sent list-item state through a whole-root replay.

A leaf setState under an idle @try boundary stays scoped; only an active suspense or error episode may fall back to the root. Rejects the blanket ancestor-boundary bail that disabled scoped updates for any app with an error boundary near the root.

A leaf update that inserts or removes one host commits through the scope's physical frame (nearest host parent plus end anchor) instead of replaying the root. Rejects the shape-stability bail that sent every structural update through a whole-root replay.

Compact leaf rows driven by their list component's selection state replay only that component (its 100 rows), so unrelated siblings must not change the cost. Rejects the compact-range bail that forced list selection through a whole-root replay.

Same-run production Chromium effectful mount/update/unmount cycles with exact listener, subscription, interval, effect-cleanup, and post-teardown correctness gates. A verified quick run measured below 2x; 3x leaves real-browser noise headroom.

Same-run Playwright typing into 512 controlled fields while preserving the input, focus, insertion caret, and latest validation. A verified quick run measured about 1.01x; 2x leaves browser and keyboard-event noise headroom.

Same-run 512-subscriber useSyncExternalStore fan-out, gated on complete visible updates, rapid-write consistency, and exact listener teardown. A verified quick run measured about 1.01x; 2x leaves real-browser scheduling headroom.

Twenty unrelated parent re-renders across 512 selector-based subscribers with the store untouched, gated on every subscriber still showing the correct total and the new generation. A verified normal eight-iteration run measured 0.98345x with zero selector calls for both frameworks; 1.5x retains scheduling-noise headroom while guarding against renewed selector recomputation or an Octane render-pass regression.

Same-run compiled ReactLynx guard on an identical 9,008-host tree with 2,000 verified native handlers. A 21-sample run measured Octane 3.67 ms vs ReactLynx 3.85 ms (0.95x); the wider bound tolerates sub-5-ms timing and GC noise.

Same-run production ReactLynx parity guard on an identical 90,008-host tree with 20,000 verified native handlers. One 21-sample run measured Octane 43.76 ms vs ReactLynx 45.57 ms (0.96x); structural gates also require one compiled run and 15 total mount commands.

First real native tap after the identical 1,000-row mount, including visible state updates. A 21-sample run measured Octane 0.83 ms vs ReactLynx 0.81 ms (1.03x); the wider ceiling accommodates sub-millisecond scheduling noise.
First real native tap after the identical 10,000-row mount. A 21-sample run measured Octane 7.62 ms vs ReactLynx 9.06 ms (0.84x); the guard prevents mount work from moving into the first interaction.

Deterministic pinned-Rspeedy artifact gate for the same semantic-checksummed app. On 2026-08-16 the issue #57 candidate measured 162569 / 157182 = 1.0343x preview gzip. This is source/build evidence only; it makes no native first-paint or timing claim.

Deterministic decoded main-program gate comparing the common host receiver plus IFR's authored first-tree graph with the preview's receiver-only program. The issue #57 source/build record is 87566 / 82070 = 1.0670x; background bytes are separately required to remain byte-identical by the harness.

Fresh-process parse+eval of the built server entry: octane's bundled runtime.server imports ~6x FASTER than react-dom/server (0.17x on 2026-07-20). 0.6 protects that cold-start advantage while leaving room for runtime growth.
Raw-renderer cold TTFB behind identical node:http hosts: octane measured 0.89x react on 2026-07-20 (41.6ms vs 47.0ms). A breach means a renderer-side cold-start regression, not host noise.

Warm shell first-byte over HTTP on the streaming page: parity with Fizz (1.02x at ~0.37ms, rme ~15%) on 2026-07-20. Guards the render-whole-shell-before-first-write design from regressing further; sub-ms op, hence generous headroom.

Warm sequential HTTP request total on the all-fast page (throughput inverse): 1.10x react on 2026-07-20 with high sub-2ms variance. Catches a per-request streaming-engine cliff (per-wave re-render bookkeeping) without pinning noisy sub-ms deltas.
Start-app cold TTFB behind line-for-line identical minimal hosts: octane measured 0.65x react on 2026-07-20 (60ms vs 93ms spawn-to-first-byte). Guards the app-layer cold-start advantage.

KNOWN GAP under active investigation: warmed /posts first-byte measured 2.57x react on 2026-07-20 (1.85ms vs 0.72ms) — the octane Start SSR stack, not the host (nitro-vs-minimal ~1x) and not the raw renderer (ssr-http shell is at parity). The 3.5 ceiling only catches further regression; renderer/Start fixes should TIGHTEN this guard.

KNOWN GAP: warmed /deferred shell first-byte measured 1.57x react on 2026-07-20 (1.57ms vs 1.00ms). Both flavors beat the 40ms defer floor (genuinely streaming); the gap is pre-shell work. Tighten alongside warm_ttfb_posts.

KNOWN GAP: warmed sequential ms/request on / measured 2.37x react on 2026-07-20 (695 vs 1650 req/s) — per-request overhead in the octane Start SSR path. The 3.5 ceiling only catches further regression; fixes should TIGHTEN it.

Host-overhead guard, renderer-independent: the nitro deployment output vs the identical app behind the minimal host measured 1.13x on 2026-07-20. A breach is a nitro/deployment regression, not an octane one.

Fully-bundled Worker script (gzip): octane's server runtime bundles to 0.36x react+react-dom's size (31KB vs 87KB on 2026-07-20). Script size drives Workers isolate cold start; 0.6 protects the advantage. Deterministic size op.

Cold workerd process + isolate + script parse to first body byte behind identical minimal Workers: octane measured 0.72x react on 2026-07-20 (36ms vs 50ms via miniflare). Guards the renderer's Workers cold-start advantage.

Warm all-fast request total through workerd (throughput inverse): parity on 2026-07-20 (~2.1ms, ~465 req/s both). Catches a per-request cliff in the web-streams path under workerd's scheduler; sub-ms shell ops stay unguarded (noisy).

Metaframework-overhead guard: the vite-plugin + adapter-cloudflare worker vs the raw octane worker measured 1.06x cold on 2026-07-20 (38ms vs 36ms). A breach means the app-core/adapter layer grew a workerd cold-start cost, independent of the renderer.

Full dashboard mount (~2,400 SVG elements incl. 150 createElementNS de-opt icons and 120 foreignObject labels). Observed 0.82x, 2026-08-07; the namespace-flagged template clone must keep octane at least react-competitive on SVG creation.

Observed 0.49x, 2026-08-07. Solid pays per-template SVG cloning plus store setup at this scale; a jump toward 0.8x means octane's SVG mount path (template parse cache, flag-3 resolution, icon de-opt creation) regressed relative to a fine-grained baseline.

40 series `d` rebuilds (+8 areas, 32 sparklines, tick/legend text, 24 gradient stops) per frame through the generic prev-guarded setAttribute path, incl. the sanitize-url toLowerCase pair per write. Observed 0.95x, 2026-08-07 — octane must not fall behind react at bulk d-churn.

Fresh-but-value-identical snapshot republish: octane walks every binding's prev-guard where solid's fine-grained graph skips at the signal layer. Observed 1.78x, 2026-08-07; this pins the diff-skip walk cost from drifting further. Observed 0.36x, 2026-08-08, after the autoMemo host-spread admission: the unchanged topology/icon subtrees now bail on identity, so the walk covers only the republished charts strip.

Per-frame topology commits (10 node+icon transforms + ~26 incident edge d rebuilds, 30 frames). Observed 1.45x at introduction (2026-08-07) and 1.89x once the react fixture adopted the React Compiler rollout (#639, 2026-08-08) — a known octane gap: each topo commit re-walks the keyed row bindings including the 150 de-opt icon holes. Tripwire against the gap widening. The autoMemo host-spread admission adds always-missing region guards to these commits; a same-session A/B (2026-08-08, pre-#639 react column) attributed only ~0.1 ms (~1.4%) of octane's 7.0 ms to them.

960 tiny ui commits (viewBox + root transform only). Measures per-commit flush overhead with the dashboard subtrees isolated behind reference-stable descriptor props. Observed 1.53x, 2026-08-07; regression here means the children-prop bail-out stopped engaging. Since the autoMemo host-spread + destructured-props admissions (2026-08-08), the compiler-owned call-site regions also bail on the colocated shape: an inline-App probe (all three domains in App, subtrees as direct children) ran pan_zoom at 134.0 ms without the spread admission (Topology re-walk per commit) and 0.6 ms with it.

Observed 0.32x, 2026-08-07. Octane's per-commit overhead beats react's memo-cascade by 3x on viewport-only writes; approaching 0.7x means either octane's ui-commit path bloated or the descriptor-prop bail-out weakened. The compiler-owned call-site regions now also cover host-spread callees (Topology's {...e.attrs} rows), so the Viewport descriptor-prop shape is a fixture choice rather than the only isolation keeping this op flat.

350 class-string rewrites per round through setClassAttr (SVG class is attribute-only). Observed 0.58x, 2026-08-07 — octane's many-small-writes profile beats solid's reconcile here; the guard rejects per-write fixed-cost regressions (alias lookup, sanitize, clsx normalize).
Keyed churn inside <svg>: -30/+30 nodes with edges/icons/foreignObject labels plus survivor rotation (LIS moves). Observed 0.93x vs svelte's keyed each, 2026-08-07.
480 foreignObject insert/removals per sample — the SVG→HTML namespace push/pop on runtime insertion. Observed 1.38x, 2026-08-07.

360 portal commits per sample into the overlay <g> (mount, two moves, unmount per cycle). Observed 0.50x, 2026-08-07 — octane portals into SVG beat react's createPortal; the guard keeps that from silently inverting.

All 150 createElement-built icons re-diff per flip (tag swaps replace elements, same-tag patches attrs) plus 150 <use href> fast-path writes. Octane's DELIBERATE de-opt path vs react's one-and-only path — a cliff-width tripwire, not a win claim. Observed 0.79x, 2026-08-07.

200 edges x (style-object diff with unitless SVG props + data-* spread bag) per pulse. Observed 1.98x, 2026-08-07 — octane's setSpread + per-property style diff currently trails react's; tripwire against the gap widening while it is worked on.
